headline: A 2007 executive order on training and developing federal workers who handle national security.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the professional development of people who work on national security for the federal government. It likely sets up or guides training, education, and career experience programs for these workers. No summary was provided, so the exact rules and programs are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who work on national security and homeland security
who_it_affects.how: They may take part in training, education, or career development programs set up under the order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies with national security duties
who_it_affects.how: They may be directed to create or coordinate programs to develop their national security staff.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 17, 2007; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
